391: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰਤਾ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਡਰਿਆ ॥
He does not die, so I do not fear.
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
He does not perish, so I do not grieve.
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੂਖੇ ॥
He is not poor, so I do not hunger.
ਨਾ ਓਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੇ ॥੧॥
He is not in pain, so I do not suffer. ॥1॥
There is no destroyer other than Him.
Long live the One who gives me life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
He is not bound, so I am not bound.
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਧੰਧਾ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਧਾਧੇ ॥
He is not entangled, so I am not entangled.
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਮੈਲੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
He has no filth, so I have no filth.
ਓਸੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਤ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
He is in bliss, so I am always happy. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਚੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
He has no anxiety, so I have no anxiety.
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਪੋਚਾ ॥
He has no stain, so I have no stain.
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਭੂਖ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
He has no hunger, so I have no thirst.
ਜਾ ਉਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਤਾਂ ਹਮ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੩॥
Since He is immaculate, I am pure as well. ॥3॥
I am nothing; He is the One and Only.
Here and hereafter, He alone is.
O Nanak, the Guru has taken away my doubts and the obstacles they made,
ਹਮ ਓਇ ਮਿਲਿ; ਹੋਏ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੮੩॥
and He and I, joining together, are of one colour. ॥4॥32॥83॥
Serve that soul-bride in so many ways;
dedicate your soul, your breath of life and your wealth to her.
Renouncing pride, I would carry water for her and fan her.
I am a sacrifice to her, over and over again. ॥1॥
She alone is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to God.
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਉ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In her company, I would meet Him, O my mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I would be the water-carrier of the slaves of her slaves.
ਉਨੑ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ; ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
May the dust of their feet stay with my soul.
If such destiny is written on my forehead, I shall obtain their company,
and through it the Lord and Master meets me in His love. ॥2॥
I would give up all chanting, penance and religious observances,
and offer up all good deeds, rituals and burnt offerings for her company.
Renouncing pride and attachment, I would become the dust of her feet.
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨ ॥੩॥
In her company, I would behold God with my eyes. ॥3॥
Each and every moment, I would contemplate this.
Day and night, I would perform this service.
The Lord of the world, the Lord of the Universe, has become merciful;
O Nanak, the Forgiving Lord is found in the company of the Holy. ॥4॥33॥84॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the love of God, everlasting peace is obtained.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਕੋਇ ॥
Through the love of God, one is not touched by pain.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Through the love of God, the filth of ego is washed away.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Through the love of God, one is forever immaculate. ॥1॥
Listen, O friend: such is the love and affection
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that becomes the support of the soul and the breath of life in each and every heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Through the love of God, all treasures are obtained.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
Through the love of God, the Immaculate Name dwells in the heart.
Through the love of God, one is forever adorned with glory.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
Through the love of God, all anxiety is ended. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
Through the love of God, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੈ ॥
Through the love of God, one does not fear the messenger of death.
Through the love of God, all are saved.
The love of God shall go along with you. ॥3॥
By oneself, no one is united, and no one goes astray.
One upon whom God is merciful is mingled into the company of the Holy.
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to You, Lord.
You are the shelter of the Saints, O God; You are their strength. ॥4॥34॥85॥
One may become a king and exercise his royal authority;
committing all sorts of wrongs, he amasses wealth.
392: Gathering and gathering, he fills his bags;
ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ; ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥੧॥
but God takes it away from him, and gives it to another. ॥1॥
The body is like an unbaked clay pot in water;
ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ; ਉਆਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
indulging in pride again and again, it crumbles and dissolves into it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
he does not think of the Creator, who is always with him.
He raises armies and collects arms,
ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਫੂਕ; ਤ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਸੁਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
but when the breath leaves him, he is reduced to ashes. ॥2॥
He may have lofty palaces, mansions and queens,
elephants, horses and fine clothes that delight the mind;
he may be blessed with a great family of sons and daughters;
and yet, engrossed in attachment, the blind man wastes away and dies. ॥3॥
The One who created him destroys him.
His enjoyments and pleasures are like a dream.
He alone is liberated, and possesses true royalty and wealth,
O slave Nanak, upon whom the Lord and Master is merciful. ॥4॥35॥86॥
The mortal is in love with Maya;
the more he meets her, the more his love increases.
She clings to his neck, and does not let go of him;
only by falling at the feet of the True Guru is one released. ॥1॥
Renouncing her, I have cast off the enticer of the world.
I have met the Lord beyond the three qualities, and congratulations pour in. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
She is so beautiful that she entices the mind.
ਬਾਟਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
On the road, at the river crossing, at home, in forest after forest, she lies in wait.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
She seems so sweet to the mind and body,
but by the Guru's grace, I have seen her to be false. ॥2॥
Her courtiers, the passions, are great deceivers;
they spare neither father nor mother.
They have bound up those who associate with them;
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
but by the Guru's grace, I have subdued them all. ॥3॥
Now my mind is filled with bliss;
my fear is gone, and all my nooses are snapped.
Says Nanak, since I found the True Guru,
my whole household dwells in peace. ॥4॥36॥87॥
Twenty-four hours a day, he knows the Lord to be near at hand;
he accepts as sweet whatever God does.
The One Name is the support of the Saints;
ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ; ਸਭ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
they remain the dust of the feet of all. ॥1॥
Listen to the way of life of the Saints, O my brother;
ਉਆ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
their glory cannot be described. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Their only occupation is the Name;
the Kirtan of the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is their rest.
ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
Friend and foe are alike to them;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
they know of no other than their God. ॥2॥
They erase millions upon millions of sins,
ਦੁਖ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ; ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
they dispel suffering, and they are givers of spiritual life.
They are brave and true to their word;
the Saints have subdued poor Maya. ॥3॥
Even the gods long for their company.
ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸੁ; ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Their vision is fruitful, and their service is rewarding.
With palms pressed together, Nanak offers his prayer:
O Lord, treasure of virtue, please bless me with the service of the Saints. ॥4॥37॥88॥
All peace is obtained by chanting the One Name.
ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
All righteous deeds are contained in singing the glorious praises of the Lord.
The company of the Holy is so very pure;
393: meeting them, love for God is embraced. ॥1॥
By the Guru's grace, one obtains such bliss —
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ. ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
remembering Him in meditation, the mind is illumined; his state and extent cannot be described. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Fasts, religious vows, cleansing baths and worship;
the Vedas, Puranas and Simritees — he has heard them all,
ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
whose heart, the dwelling place, is supremely pure and immaculate,
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
and who has the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the company of the Holy. ॥2॥
That humble being becomes renowned throughout all the worlds;
ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
even sinners are purified by the dust of his feet.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
One who has met the Lord, the Sovereign King —
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
his state and extent cannot be described. ॥3॥
Twenty-four hours a day, with palms pressed together, I meditate on You, Lord,
and I long for the vision of those Holy Saints.
Merge me, the poor one, with them;
O Nanak, I have come and fallen into Your sanctuary. ॥4॥38॥89॥
Twenty-four hours a day, He takes His cleansing bath in all the waters,
and the all-wise Lord forever partakes of the food offered to Him.
He leaves no one's suffering unheeded.
Again and again, I fall at His feet. ॥1॥
The service of the Lord is my worship of the Saalagraam stone.
This is my worship, my offering of flowers and my bowing to the Divine Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘੰਟਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ; ਸੁਨੀਐ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ॥
His bell is heard in the four directions;
His seat is forever in heaven.
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਚਵਰੁ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਝੂਲੈ ॥
His incense is the ever-blossoming flowers. ॥2॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੰਪਟੁ; ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
He is treasured in each and every heart;
His eternal court is the company of the Holy.
His Aarti is the Kirtan of His praise, which brings lasting bliss;
His greatness is so beautiful, and forever infinite. ॥3॥
He alone obtains Him, who is so destined;
he takes to the sanctuary of the Saints' feet.
I hold in my hands the Lord, the Saalagraam;
says Nanak, the Guru has given me this gift. ॥4॥39॥90॥
That path on which the water-carrier is plundered —
that way is far removed from the Saints. ॥1॥
The perfect True Guru has spoken the Truth:
ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਬੀਥੀ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your Name, Lord, is the path to liberation, and the road of the messenger of death is far away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
That place where the greedy tax-collectors keep the river crossing —
ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ; ਉਹ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਟ ॥੨॥
that path remains far away from the Lord's humble servant. ॥2॥
Where there are so many caravans of people suffering,
the Holy are companions of the Supreme Lord God. ॥3॥
Chitr and Gupt, the recording scribes, write the accounts of all,
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੪॥
but they cannot even look upon the Lord's humble devotees. ॥4॥
Says Nanak, one who has the perfect True Guru —
the unstruck melodies of bliss vibrate for him. ॥5॥40॥91॥
In the company of the Holy, I have been taught the Name;
all my hopes and tasks are fulfilled.
ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ॥
My thirst has been quenched, and I am satiated with the Lord's praise.
I live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ॥1॥
I have entered the sanctuary of the Creator, the Cause of causes.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ. ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, I have found the home of intuitive peace; the darkness is dispelled, and the moon has risen. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
394: The treasure-houses are overflowing with rubies and jewels;
they never run short, chanting the Name of the Formless Lord.
How rare is the humble servant who drinks in the ambrosial Word;
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
O Nanak, he attains the state of supreme dignity. ॥2॥41॥92॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
I meditate continually on the Lord's Name within my heart.
Thus I save all my companions and associates. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
My Guru is always with me, near at hand.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Your actions seem so sweet to me, Lord.
Nanak begs for the treasure of the Lord's Name. ॥2॥42॥93॥
In the company of the Holy, the world-ocean is crossed;
the Lord's Name is the support of the mind. ॥1॥
The lotus feet of the Beloved Divine Guru —
ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੰਤ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Saints worship them with love and affection for the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who has such good destiny written on his forehead —
says Nanak, his good fortune is eternal. ॥2॥43॥94॥
The Order of my Husband Lord seems so sweet to me.
My Husband Lord has driven out the rival wife, Maya, from my home.
My Beloved has adorned me as His happy soul-bride,
and has quenched the burning thirst of my mind. ॥1॥
It is good that I accepted the Will of my Beloved;
ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ; ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have come to know the peace and poise within this home of my heart. ॥ Rahao ॥
I am the handmaiden, the attendant of my Beloved.
He is eternal and imperishable, inaccessible and infinite.
Holding the fan, sitting at His feet, I wave it over my Beloved,
and the five demons that cut away at the roots of life have run away. ॥2॥
I am not of noble birth, nor am I adorned with glory;
what do I know? Why am I pleasing to my Husband Lord?
I am a poor orphan, destitute and dishonoured;
my Husband Lord took me by the arm, and made me His queen. ॥3॥
When I beheld the face of my Beloved, my friend,
I found peace and poise; blessed is my married life.
Says Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled;
the True Guru has united me with God, the treasure of virtue. ॥4॥1॥95॥
There is a frown on her forehead, and her look is cruel.
Her speech is bitter, and her tongue is rude.
She is always hungry, and she believes her Husband to be far away. ॥1॥
Such is the woman, Maya, whom the Lord has created.
ਉਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ; ਹਮ. ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
She has devoured the whole world, but the Guru has saved me, O my brother. ॥ Rahao ॥
Administering her drug, she has kept her eye on the whole world.
She has enticed Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
Those Gurmukhs who are attuned to the Name are beautiful. ॥2॥
Performing fasts, religious vows and atonements, people have grown weary.
They wander over the whole earth, to the banks of the sacred rivers.
ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ; ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
They alone are saved, who seek the sanctuary of the True Guru. ॥3॥
Attached to Maya, the whole world is in bondage.
The foolish self-willed manmukhs are consumed by their ego.
ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ. ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯੬॥
Taking me by the arm, O Nanak, the Guru has saved me. ॥4॥2॥96॥
All pains come when You are forgotten, O Lord and Master;
such a mortal is of no use, here or hereafter. ॥1॥
The Saints are satisfied, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.
395: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ; ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Showing His mercy, He attaches them to His Name; all peace comes, God, by Your Will. ॥ Rahao ॥
One who believes the Lord, who is ever-present, to be far away,
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਰਤਾ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
dies a spiritual death, grieving day after day. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
One who does not remember the Lord, who has given him everything,
ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
passes his days and nights entangled in terrible corruption. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance on the One God;
emancipation is obtained in the shelter of the perfect Guru. ॥4॥3॥97॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
Chanting the Name, the mind and body are totally rejuvenated.
All sins and sorrows are washed away. ॥1॥
That day alone is blessed, O my brothers,
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when one sings the glorious praises of the Lord and attains the supreme state. ॥ Rahao ॥
One who worships the feet of the Holy —
his mischief and hatred are erased from his mind. ॥2॥
Meeting the perfect Guru, the conflict within is ended,
and the five demons are totally subdued. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
One whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord —
Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ॥4॥4॥98॥
O singer, sing of the One,
who is the support of the soul, the body and the breath of life.
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Serving Him, all peace is obtained,
ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
and you shall no longer go to any other. ॥1॥
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ. ਅਨੰਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
My blissful Lord and Master is forever in bliss; meditate continually on Him, the treasure of virtue.
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Beloved Saint, by whose grace God comes to dwell in the mind. ॥ Rahao ॥
in so many ways, all are absorbed in intuitive poise.
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
enshrine that True Lord within your mind. ॥2॥
ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ॥
His house is filled with all sorts of things;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ; ਦੂਖ ਨ ਝੂਰਨ ॥
God's servants never suffer pain or grief.
Holding fast to His support, the state of fearless dignity is obtained.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ; ਸੋ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
With each and every breath, sing of the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ॥3॥
He is not far from us, wherever we go.
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
When He shows His grace, we obtain the Lord, Har, Har.
I offer this prayer to the perfect Guru:
Nanak begs for the treasure of the Lord's wealth. ॥4॥5॥99॥
First, the pains of the body vanished;
then the whole mind became peaceful.
In His mercy, the Guru blessed me with the Name.
ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that True Guru. ॥1॥
I have obtained the perfect Guru, O my brothers.
ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All illness, sorrow and suffering are dispelled in the sanctuary of the True Guru. ॥ Rahao ॥
I have enshrined the feet of the Guru within my heart;
I have received all the fruits of my mind's desires.
The fire has been put out, and I am totally at peace.
Showering His mercy, the Guru has given this gift. ॥2॥
The Guru has given shelter to the shelterless.
The Guru has given honour to the dishonoured.
Cutting away my bonds, He has kept me as His servant,
and now my tongue tastes the Ambrosial Bani. ॥3॥
By great good fortune, I worship the Guru's feet;
renouncing everything, I have obtained God's sanctuary.
396: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
That humble being upon whom Guru Nanak is merciful
The True Lord has sent the True Guru into the world.
Through His company, eternal spiritual life has been born.
When the child comes to dwell in the mother's womb,
the mother's heart is filled with joy. ॥1॥
A son is born — a devotee of the Lord of the Universe.
ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰ ਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The pre-ordained destiny has been revealed among all. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ; ਹੁਕਮਿ. ਬਾਲਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
In the tenth month, by the Lord's Command, the baby is born;
sorrow is dispelled, and great joy ensues.
The companions sing the songs of bliss of the Guru's Bani,
and are pleasing to the mind of the True Lord and Master. ॥2॥
The vine has grown, and shall last for many generations.
The Lord has firmly established the power of righteousness.
That which my mind longed for, the True Guru has granted.
I have become carefree, and fix my attention on the One Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ; ਪਿਤਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
As the child places so much faith in his father,
I speak as it pleases the Guru to have me speak.
This is not a hidden secret;
Guru Nanak, being pleased, has bestowed this gift. ॥4॥7॥101॥
Giving His hand, the perfect Guru has protected His servant;
the glory of His humble servant has become manifest. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਪੀ; ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
I chant the Guru, the Guru; I meditate on the Guru, the Guru.
ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ; ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I offer the prayer of my soul to the Guru, and it is granted. ॥ Rahao ॥
I have taken to the sanctuary of the True Divine Guru;
the service of His servant has been fulfilled. ॥2॥
He has preserved my soul, body, youth and breath of life.
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ॥3॥8॥102॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
I am Your slave, bought and paid for; You are my True Lord and Master.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
My soul and body all belong to Him; everything is Yours, Lord. ॥1॥
ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ; ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
You are the honour of the dishonoured, O Master; in You I place my trust.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ. ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who leans on any support other than the True One — know him to be weak and false. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ; ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Your Command is infinite; no one can find its limit.
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ; ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
One who meets the perfect Guru walks in the Way of the Lord's Will. ॥2॥
ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ; ਕਿਤੈ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
Cunning and cleverness are of no use;
ਤੁਠਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
that which the Lord and Master gives, being pleased, is the peace that is obtained. ॥3॥
ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ; ਕਿਛੁ. ਪਵੈ ਨ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
One may perform hundreds of thousands of deeds, but they put no check on suffering.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ; ਹੋਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦੩॥
Servant Nanak has made the Name his support, and has renounced all other entanglements. ॥4॥1॥103॥
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਭਾਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
I have searched through all comforts, but none is as great as the Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
By the Guru's pleasure, the True Lord and Master is obtained. ॥1॥
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.
ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ; ਇਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Please bless me with this one gift, that I may never forget the Name, even for an instant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਾਗਠੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸੁ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
He alone is truly wealthy, who has the wealth of the Lord within his heart.
397: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥੨॥
He is released from the great net, who has the Guru's Word within him, ever and always. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ. ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
What praise of the Guru can I speak? The Guru is the ocean of discerning wisdom and of truth.
ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੁ; ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
He is the embodiment of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
Meditate forever and ever on the Name, and let your mind be dyed in the love of the Lord, Har, Har.
ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
The Guru is the soul, the breath of life and the wealth; He is ever with Nanak. ॥4॥2॥104॥
ਸਾਈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ; ਭੋਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
When the unseen and infinite Master comes to dwell in my mind, even for a moment,
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ; ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
all my pain, suffering and disease run away, O mother. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to my Master.
ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meditating on Him, great bliss wells up in my mind and body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿੰਦਕ ਗਾਲੑਿ ਸੁਣੀ; ਸਚੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
I have heard just a little bit of the praise of the True Lord Master;
ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ; ਮਾਇ. ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
I have obtained the peace of peace, O mother; I cannot estimate its worth. ॥2॥
ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਸੋਇ; ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ ਭਈ ॥
He is so pleasing to my eyes; beholding Him, I have become enraptured.
ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ; ਆਪਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
I am worthless, O my mother; He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe. ॥3॥
ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸੰਸਾਰ; ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
He is beyond the Vedas, the Bible, the Koran and the whole world.
Nanak's Sovereign King is manifest everywhere. ॥4॥3॥105॥
ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ; ਜਪਤੇ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
Hundreds of thousands of devotees worship and adore You, chanting "Beloved, Beloved."
ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਉ; ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
How shall I, a worthless and corrupt soul, be united with You? ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥
You are my support, O merciful God, Lord of the Universe, Sustainer of the world.
ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are the Master of all; the whole creation is Yours. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤ; ਪੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
You are the constant help and support of the Saints, who behold You ever-present.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੜਿਆ; ਸੇ ਮਰਨੑਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Those who lack the Name die, grieving and grieving. ॥2॥
ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਤਣ ਭਾਇ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗਉਣੁ ॥
Those who are lovingly committed to being the slaves of Your slaves — their coming and going ends.
ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਹਾਲੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੩॥
What will be the condition of those who have forgotten the Name? ॥3॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਰੑਿਆਉ; ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
As the stray animal grazes on the green crops, so is the whole world.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ; ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦੬॥
O God, cut away Nanak's bonds, and unite him with Yourself. ॥4॥4॥106॥
ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ; ਹਿਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
Forget all other things, and concentrate on the One Lord.
ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੧॥
Abandon your false pride, and dedicate your mind and body to Him. ॥1॥
Twenty-four hours a day, I praise You, O Creator Lord.
ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ. ਮੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I live by Your gift; please, be merciful to me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
Do only that work by which your face shall be radiant.
ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਲਾ ॥੨॥
He alone is attached to the Truth, O Lord, to whom You give it. ॥2॥
ਜੋ. ਨ ਢਹੰਦੋ ਮੂਲਿ; ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
Build and adorn that house which shall never fall.
ਹਿਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇ; ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ॥੩॥
Enshrine the One Lord in your consciousness; He shall never die. ॥3॥
ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
The Lord is dear to those who are pleasing to God's Will.
By the Guru's grace, Nanak describes the indescribable. ॥4॥5॥107॥
ਜਿਨੑਾ. ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੇ ਕਿਨੇਹਿਆ ॥
What are they like, those who do not forget the Name?
ਭੇਦੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ; ਸਾਂਈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
Know that there is absolutely no difference; they are just like the Lord and Master. ॥1॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ; ਤੁਮੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
The mind and body are enraptured, meeting with You, Lord.
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Peace is obtained by the grace of the Lord's humble servant, and all pain is taken away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੇਤੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ; ਉਧਾਰੇ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
As many continents and worlds as there are, they are able to save.
ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ; ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
Those in whose minds the Lord Himself has come to dwell are the perfect devotees. ॥2॥
398: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪਿ; ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
One whom the Lord Himself honours is honoured everywhere.
ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ; ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥
That person is renowned and accepted, and known in all places. ॥3॥
ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ; ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ॥
Day and night, I worship and adore You; with each and every breath, I cherish You.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ; ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
Please fulfil Nanak's longing, O True Sovereign King. ॥4॥6॥108॥
ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਇ; ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
He, my Lord and Master, is pervading and permeating all places.
ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
He is the One Lord and Master, the canopy over my head; there is no other at all. ॥1॥
As it pleases You, please save me, O Saviour Lord.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ; ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without You, my eyes see no other. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
God Himself is the Cherisher; He takes care of each and every heart.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
That person within whose mind He Himself dwells — He never forgets him. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਿ; ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
Whatever He does, He does by Himself, according to His own pleasure.
ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
He is known as the help and support of His devotees, throughout the ages. ॥3॥
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
Chanting and meditating on the Lord's Name, one never grieves.
Nanak thirsts for the vision of Your Darshan, Lord; please fulfil his longing. ॥4॥7॥109॥
ਕਿਆ ਸੋਵਹਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ; ਗਾਫਲ ਗਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
Why are you sleeping, having forgotten the Name, O careless, heedless mortal?
So many have been washed away and carried off by this river of life. ॥1॥
ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ; ਮਨ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ ॥
The Lord's feet are the boat; climbing aboard it, O mind, cross over.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Twenty-four hours a day, sing the glorious praises of the Lord, in the company of the Holy. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁੰਞਿਆ ॥
You may enjoy many pleasures, but they are useless without the Name.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ; ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
Without devotion to the Lord, people die again and again, and weep. ॥2॥
ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ; ਤਨਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਲਣਾ ॥
You may wear fine clothes, eat delicacies and rub scented oils on your body,
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ. ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ; ਸਰਪਰ ਚਾਲਣਾ ॥੩॥
but without remembering the Lord in meditation, your body shall turn to dust, and you shall surely depart. ॥3॥
How rare is the one who sees that this world-ocean is so treacherous!
ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
Release is found in the Lord's sanctuary, O Nanak, for one with such destiny written on his forehead. ॥4॥8॥110॥
ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ ॥
No one is anyone's companion forever; why should anyone take pride in others?
With the support of the One Name, this terrifying world-ocean is crossed. ॥1॥
ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ. ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ; ਮੇਰੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
You are the true support of me, a poor mortal, O my perfect True Guru.
ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੋ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beholding the vision of Your Darshan, my mind is encouraged. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ; ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ. ਗਨੋੁ ॥
Royal powers, wealth and worldly involvements are an entanglement; know that they are of no use at all.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੋੁ ॥੨॥
The Kirtan of the Lord's praises is my support; this wealth is everlasting. ॥2॥
As many as are the pleasures of Maya, so many are the shadows they leave.
ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
The Name is the treasure of peace; the Gurmukh sings its praises. ॥3॥
ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
You are the True Lord, the treasure of virtue; O God, You are deep and unfathomable.
ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
The Lord and Master is the hope and support of Nanak's soul. ॥4॥9॥111॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Remembering Him in meditation, pain departs, and celestial peace is obtained.
ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Night and day, with palms pressed together, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
He alone is Nanak's God, to whom everyone belongs.
ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ; ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is totally pervading everywhere; He is the Truest of the true. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਹਾਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Inwardly and outwardly, He is with you, your help and support, the One worth knowing.
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮਨਾ; ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Worship Him in adoration, O my mind, and all your sickness shall be cured. ॥2॥
The Saviour Lord is infinite; He saves us even in the fire of the womb.
399: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is cooling; remembering it, the burning departs. ॥3॥
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
Peace, poise and great bliss are obtained, O Nanak, by becoming the dust of the feet of the humble.
ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ; ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
All one's affairs are perfectly resolved, meeting the perfect Guru. ॥4॥10॥112॥
The Lord of the Universe is the treasure of virtue; He is known only through the Guru.
ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
When He shows His mercy and compassion, one revels in the Lord's love. ॥1॥
ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
Come, O Saints, let us join together and speak the sermon of the Lord.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Night and day, let us meditate on the Name, disregarding the shame of the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
I live by chanting and meditating on the Name, and great bliss wells up within.
Attachment to the world is useless and false; it shall perish. ॥2॥
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹੁ; ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
How rare is the one who embraces love for the lotus feet of the Lord!
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਮੁਖੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Blessed and beautiful is the mouth that meditates on the Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ; ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
The pains of birth, death and the fear of death are erased by remembering Him in meditation.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
That alone is peace to Nanak, which is pleasing to God. ॥4॥11॥113॥
ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ. ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ; ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਹ ॥
Come, my friends, let us meet together and enjoy all the tastes and flavours.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹ; ਮਿਲਿ. ਪਾਪਾ ਮੁੰਚਹ ॥੧॥
Let us chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and wash away our sins. ॥1॥
ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Reflect upon the essence of reality, O Saints, so that no obstacles shall block your way.
ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਤਸਕਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All the thieves are destroyed, for the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੁਧਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈਹੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
Take humble wisdom as your provisions for the journey, and burn away the poison of ego.
ਸਾਚਾ ਹਟੁ, ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ; ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
True is the shop, and perfect the transaction; deal only in the merchandise of the Name. ॥2॥
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ; ਸੇਈ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
They alone are honoured, who dedicate their soul, body and wealth.
ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ; ਨਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤੇ ॥੩॥
Those who are pleasing to their God celebrate in joy forever. ॥3॥
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਦੁ. ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ; ਬਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਕਮਲੀ ॥
Those who drink the wine of evil-mindedness become wicked, and their honour turns to madness.
ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
But those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, O Nanak, are intoxicated with the True Name. ॥4॥12॥114॥
I made the effort, as the Guru inspired me, and began the work of chanting the Name.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
I chant the Name, and by chanting it I live; the Guru has implanted the Mantra within me. ॥1॥
ਪਾਇ ਪਰਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥
Let us fall at the feet of the True Guru, who has dispelled our doubts.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Granting His grace, God has adorned us, establishing His True Name within us. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ; ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Taking me by the hand, He has made me His own; True is His Command and His Will.
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
The gift which God has given me is perfect glory. ॥2॥
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Forever and ever, I sing His glorious praises, chanting the Name of the Lord, the Destroyer of pride.
ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
The True Guru has fulfilled my vow; God has showered His grace. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ; ਲਾਭੁ. ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
The Name is my wealth; I sing His glorious praises — this is the profit the perfect Guru has given me.
ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੧੫॥
The Saints are the traders, O Nanak, and God is the Banker of infinite wealth. ॥4॥13॥115॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
One who has You, O God, as his Lord and Master is blessed with great destiny.
ਓਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ; ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
He is happy and forever at peace; his doubts and fears are all dispelled. ॥1॥
ਹਮ ਚਾਕਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ; ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
I am the slave of the Lord of the Universe; my Lord and Master is the greatest of all.
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ; ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is the Creator, the Cause of causes in every way; He is my True Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋ; ਤਾ. ਕਾ ਭਉ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
There is no other whom I should fear.
400: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ. ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
Serving the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's presence is obtained, and the treacherous world-ocean is crossed. ॥2॥
ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
By Your glance of grace, peace is obtained, and the treasure fills the mind.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ; ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Those servants upon whom You are merciful are accepted. ॥3॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੋ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
How rare is the one who drinks in the ambrosial essence of the Kirtan of the Lord's praises.
ਵਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੧੬॥
O Nanak, one who receives the wages of the One Name lives by chanting and meditating on it in the heart. ॥4॥14॥116॥
ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ. ਹਉ ਚੇਰੁਲੀ; ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
The God whose handmaiden I am is the highest of all.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ; ਥੋਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
Everything, great and small, is said to be His. ॥1॥
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੋ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮਨੀਆ ॥
My soul, my breath of life and my wealth I accept as the gifts of my Lord and Master.
ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਊਜਲੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਗਨੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through His Name I have become radiant; I count myself His slave. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੈ; ਨਾਉ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
You are carefree, the embodiment of bliss; Your Name is a gem and a jewel.
ਰਜੀ ਧਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
One who has You as her Sovereign is satisfied, fulfilled and forever at peace. ॥2॥
ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ; ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਉ ॥
O my companions and friends, I implant this sublime advice within you:
ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਤਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
serve the Holy Guru with love, and you shall obtain the treasure of the Lord. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ; ਸਭ ਕਹਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
All are handmaidens of the Lord and Master; all say, "He is mine."
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੧੭॥
She whom the Lord adorns, O Nanak, dwells in peace. ॥4॥15॥117॥
ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਰੀ; ਏਹੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥
Become the handmaiden of the Saints, and learn this way of life.
ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਊਤਮੋ; ਭਰਤਾ. ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਪਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
Of all virtues, the most sublime is to see your Husband Lord not far away. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥
O beautiful one, dye this mind of yours in the fast colour of the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ; ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Renounce cleverness and cunning, and know that the Lord of the world is with you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਰਤਾ ਕਹੈ. ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ; ਏਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
Whatever your Husband Lord says, accept that; make this your adornment.
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ; ਏਹੁ ਤੰਬੋਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
Forget the love of duality; chew on this betel leaf. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੋ; ਇਹ ਸਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ ਬਿਛਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
Make the Word of the Guru your lamp, and spread the bed of truth.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ. ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਰਹੁ; ਤਉ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
Twenty-four hours a day, stand with palms pressed together, and the Lord, your King, shall meet you. ॥3॥
ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ; ਸਾਈ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥
She alone is cultured and embellished, and she alone is of incomparable beauty,
ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜੋ ਭਾਣੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੧੮॥
and she alone is the happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who is pleasing to the Creator Lord. ॥4॥16॥118॥
ਡੀਗਨ ਡੋਲਾ ਤਊ ਲਉ; ਜਉ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
As long as there is doubt in the mind, the mortal stumbles and falls.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ. ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ; ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
When the Guru removes his doubt, he finds his place of rest. ॥1॥
ਓਇ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੋਖੀਆ; ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੂਟੇ ॥
Those quarrelsome enemies are overcome through the Guru.
ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਅਬ ਉਨੑਾ ਤੇ; ਓਇ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am now released from them, and they have departed from me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਨਤਾ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
One who thinks of "mine" and "yours" is bound from then on.
ਗੁਰਿ. ਕਾਟੀ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ; ਤਬ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
When the Guru dispelled my ignorance, the noose of death was cut away from my neck. ॥2॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝਤਾ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
As long as one does not understand the Command of God's Will, he remains miserable.
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥੩॥
Meeting the Guru, he comes to recognise the Lord's Will, and then he becomes happy. ॥3॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੋਖੀਆ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
I have no enemies or adversaries; no one is wicked to me.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ; ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੧੯॥
The servant who performs the Guru's service, O Nanak, is the slave of the Lord and Master. ॥4॥17॥119॥
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Peace, celestial poise and great bliss are obtained, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's praises.
ਗਰਹ. ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਦੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
The True Guru has dispelled the evil planetary influences, giving me His Name. ॥1॥
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.
